description: Get daily price candles for ONE crypto COIN (not a stock: BTC here is Bitcoin), newest first: open, high, low, close, volume in the coin's own units and trades, in US dollars. A day runs midnight to midnight UTC; a day without trades has no candle. History goes back to the coin's first trade on the exchange (BTC: 2013). Prices and volume are one exchange's, not the whole market's. Plus and Pro also get the day in progress; Free gets a day 4 hours after it ends. GetCryptoQuote has the latest price, GetCryptoIntradayPrices candles within the day, ListCryptoAssets the symbols.

endDate.description: Last UTC day in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: today)

maxResults.description: Maximum days to return, newest first (default: 60, max: 500)

startDate.description: First UTC day in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: the coin's first trade)

symbol.description: Coin symbol, e.g. BTC; BTC/USD and BTC-USD also work

name: GetCryptoPrices
title: Crypto Daily Prices
